summary: Supplied evidence supports usable topical navigation, architecture documentation, domain knowledge and risk-based oversight. Setup, tools, validation, safety policy and durable recording mechanisms are discoverable. Operational reliability, documentation maintenance and habitual feedback remain unestablished. Instruction scoping, task decomposition and observability remain unassessed because the bounded evidence supports neither a positive level nor an absence conclusion.
